not_met.lacks: Changing the form of the Design tree, the data every part reads, the developer finds no one place for it. The plugin best practice it builds on has a rewritten document such as the design tree keep a schema that a script checks, but rn/architecture.md:890 lists the schemas in domain/forms/ as each role's in and out, Change, Tree edit, Making record, and Answers, and leaves out the Design tree. rn/architecture.md:361 gives the form of the design tree to tree.py, whose code lies in domain/*.py, as rn/architecture.md:894 says. So the developer can't tell whether the tree's form belongs in domain/forms/ or in tree.py's code, and a change to it can land in either or both.
